executive_summary: A compromised internal host (202.10.10.11) established a covert DNS tunneling channel to malicious domains under the auth.dns2tcp-txt.com namespace. The attacker leveraged high‑entropy TXT queries to exfiltrate data and maintain command‑and‑control communications with external infrastructure (198.41.0.10). The activity indicates a focused data‑exfiltration campaign targeting the organization’s internal network.

attack_timeline.description: Internal host compromised via phishing attachment, installing a DNS tunneling client.
Compromised host initiates high‑entropy DNS TXT queries to AAAAAOJTAA.=auth.dns2tcp-txt.com, establishing a covert channel.
Sensitive files are encoded and exfiltrated over the DNS tunnel in successive TXT responses.
Malware attempts to delete its binaries and persists via scheduled task, but the tunnel remains active.

mitre_attack.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel

detection_gaps: No existing DNS entropy or length based detections; lack of rules for suspicious TXT sub‑domain patterns; insufficient thresholding on rapid DNS TXT queries to the same authoritative domain; no monitoring of DNS query size >200 bytes for internal hosts.
recommended_snort_rules: alert dns $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET DNS Tunneling High Entropy TXT Query"; flow:to_server,established; dns_query; content:"auth.dns2tcp-txt.com",nocase,fast_pattern; pcre:"/^[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}\.auth\.dns2tcp-txt\.com$/smi"; classtype:bad-unknown; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
alert dns $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET DNS Query Length >200 bytes (possible tunneling)"; flow:to_server,established; dns_query; dsize:>200; classtype:bad-unknown; sid:1000002; rev:1;)

alert dns $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET DNS TXT Query to suspicious auth.dns2tcp-txt.com"; flow:to_server,established; dns_query; content:"auth.dns2tcp-txt.com",nocase,fast_pattern; threshold:type both, track by_src, count 10, seconds 60; classtype:bad-unknown; sid:1000003; rev:1;)
